source: Source: Audemars Piguet; Watches by SJX

slides.headline: Its bezel is a rare metal
slides.body: The polished bezel and centre links are bulk metallic glass, a palladium alloy AP helped develop.

slides.headline: Why it's called glass
slides.body: It's cooled in seconds, so it hardens the way glass does instead of like normal metal. Pd500 on the back marks the palladium.

slides.headline: That makes it hard to scratch
slides.body: So AP left it mirror-polished, next to brushed titanium and a smoked red dial.
